note: Lesson is a long cooking/restaurant conversation with many Latin-letter stretches (31:49-32:48, 37:56-41:01, 42:37, 49:27-49:42, 52:19-53:11, 1:08:03-1:09:04). The engine writes spoken Arabic numbers as digits (Amal 06:41 'طيب، 21') - a digit never proves English (see challenge A39). The engine also drops the y- of bi-/by- (بصير, بحرق) - such one-letter rows with no voiced signal were not kept (D25 dropped, A59 challenged). D16/D17 are the same 49:00 line holding two different errors (A2 idafa + the word مقلاة); both readers found both, the matching just crossed - keep both. D26 (12:56) is the first occurrence of الـ آخر الأسبوع; D4 (15:00) is its repeat. D32 (49:27) and D28 (18:06) are repeats within 30 s of a fix (GR-28). Names (amrica, Palestine, Iran, China, Italy, Japanese, Ramallah, Bethlehem, Oman, Qatar, UAE) were never counted.
